executable_post-legion-workstation.sh.pattern: official vendor CLI installers (chezmoi, taskfile, uv, ruff, mise, bun, deno, rustup) gated by host workstation convergence
executable_post-legion-workstation.sh.reason: Workstation convergence script (post-legion-workstation.sh) runs official vendor bootstrap installers only when the corresponding binary is absent from ~/.local/bin, with all git asset fetches pinned to immutable commit SHAs or release tags.

executable_post-ollama.sh.pattern: curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | $SUDO sh  (official Ollama Linux installer)
executable_post-ollama.sh.reason: Official Ollama Linux installer (https://ollama.com/install.sh) used only on Linux hosts when an active NVIDIA GPU is detected (or OLLAMA_ALLOW_LINUX_CPU=1 is explicitly set), with the systemd service immediately locked to 127.0.0.1:11434.

run_after_21-cua-spaces.sh.tmpl.reason: Official cua.ai installer and the only install method cua offers. Mitigated: the gate runs it with --dry-run FIRST and only proceeds to --yes if the dry-run succeeds (per cua-spaces-integration.md). cua publishes no upstream checksum; the dry-run is the mitigation. Gated behind the #101 Cua Spaces provisioning gate (RAM/OS/consent).
